mcp.name: KitSolo
mcp.tagline: 你的 AI 文本与数据工具箱
mcp.taglineEn: Text and data tools for your AI agent
mcp.desc: 使用统一账号弹窗关联后，StudySolo Agent 可直接检索工具、处理 JSON、编码、哈希和时间戳；结果以卡片反馈并提供工作台入口。
mcp.descEn: Connect using your 1037Solo account in a popup. StudySolo Agent can search tools and process JSON, encoding, hashes and timestamps, with result cards and workspace links.
mcp.notes: 此插件有原生 Agent 接入。点击关联后，下一轮对话自动启用；其他 MCP 条目仍由外部宿主执行。输入发送至 KitSolo 进行本次计算，不保存。可在 KitSolo 关联管理页撤销。
mcp.notesEn: Native Agent integration. Connect to enable it in the next turn; other MCP entries still run in external hosts. Inputs are sent to KitSolo for transient processing and are not stored. Revoke access from KitSolo connection settings.
mcp.author: 1037Solo

mcp.name: Filesystem
mcp.tagline: 让 Agent 读写你指定的本地目录
mcp.taglineEn: Read/write local files inside directories you allow
mcp.desc: 官方 MCP server：把本机目录安全地开放给 Agent——读课件、整理导出文件、批量改名都在许可目录内完成。
mcp.descEn: Official MCP server: securely exposes chosen local directories to the agent — read courseware, organize exports, batch-rename files.
mcp.notes: 最实用的本地能力扩展：配合允许目录白名单使用，Agent 只能碰你授权的文件夹。
mcp.notesEn: The most practical local capability: agents only touch whitelisted folders.
mcp.author: Model Context Protocol

env.name: FILESYSTEM_DIR
env.desc: 允许访问的目录绝对路径（可重复多个参数）。
env.descEn: Absolute path of the directory to expose (repeatable for multiple dirs).

mcp.name: Fetch
mcp.tagline: 抓取网页正文并转成 Markdown
mcp.taglineEn: Fetch a URL and return its content as Markdown
mcp.desc: 官方 MCP server：给一个网址就拉回正文，自动清洗成 Markdown，适合查资料、读文档、核对引用。
mcp.descEn: Official MCP server: fetches a URL and returns cleaned Markdown — handy for research, docs and citation checks.
mcp.author: Model Context Protocol

mcp.name: GitHub
mcp.tagline: 只读仓库、代码、Issue 与 PR 学习资料
mcp.taglineEn: Read repositories, code, issues and PRs for study
mcp.desc: GitHub 官方远程 MCP：检索仓库、代码、Issue 和 PR。本产品的学习连接默认只读，账号授权由学习服务连接管理完成。
mcp.descEn: Official GitHub remote MCP for repositories, code, issues and pull requests. Native learning connections are read-only and use account authorization.
mcp.author: GitHub
mcp.notes: 本产品可在学习服务连接管理中关联 GitHub。其他客户端需要支持远程 MCP 与对应授权；本项目的用户凭证不会复制到客户端配置。
mcp.notesEn: Connect GitHub in native learning connection settings. Other clients need remote MCP and authorization support; StudySolo user credentials are not exported.

mcp.name: Puppeteer
mcp.tagline: 让 Agent 开浏览器：截图、填表、抓动态页
mcp.taglineEn: Browser automation: screenshots, form fills, dynamic pages
mcp.desc: 官方 MCP server：起一个真实 Chromium 做页面操作——截图、点按钮、抓 SPA 渲染后的内容。
mcp.descEn: Official MCP server: drives a real Chromium — screenshots, clicks, scraping JS-rendered pages.
mcp.author: Model Context Protocol

mcp.name: Brave Search
mcp.tagline: 隐私友好的全网搜索 API
mcp.desc: 官方 MCP server：接 Brave Search API 做网页/本地搜索，结果干净无广告，适合给 Agent 加联网检索。
mcp.descEn: Official MCP server on the Brave Search API — clean web/local search results for agent lookups.
mcp.author: Model Context Protocol

env.name: BRAVE_API_KEY
env.desc: Brave Search API 密钥（免费档每月 2000 次）。
env.descEn: Brave Search API key (free tier: 2,000 queries/month).

mcp.name: Memory
mcp.tagline: 跨对话记住知识图谱式的长期记忆
mcp.desc: 官方 MCP server：把实体—关系存成知识图谱，Agent 每轮可查可写，适合累积错题本、术语表、学习画像。
mcp.descEn: Official MCP server: persists entities and relations as a knowledge graph — good for accumulating mistakes, glossaries and learner profiles.
mcp.author: Model Context Protocol

mcp.name: Sequential Thinking
mcp.tagline: 把大问题拆成可修订的思考链
mcp.taglineEn: Break hard problems into revisable thinking steps
mcp.desc: 官方 MCP server：给 Agent 一个显式的「分步推理」工具——假设、修正、分支、结论逐条推进，适合复杂分析题。
mcp.descEn: Official MCP server: gives the agent an explicit stepwise-reasoning tool — hypotheses, revisions, branches, conclusions.
mcp.author: Model Context Protocol

mcp.name: Time
mcp.tagline: 时区换算与当前时间查询
mcp.desc: 官方 MCP server：给出准确当前时间与任意时区换算，排复习计划、定时任务排期都用得上。
mcp.descEn: Official MCP server: exact current time and timezone conversion — useful for study plans and schedules.
mcp.author: Model Context Protocol

mcp.name: Postgres
mcp.tagline: 只读 SQL 查询你的数据库
mcp.taglineEn: Read-only SQL queries against your database
mcp.desc: 官方存档 MCP server：对 PostgreSQL 跑只读 SELECT，查自建题库、学习记录库很方便。连接串里含库密码，注意保管。
mcp.descEn: Official (archived) MCP server: read-only SELECTs on PostgreSQL — handy for a self-hosted question bank. The connection string carries credentials; keep it safe.
mcp.author: Model Context Protocol

env.name: DATABASE_URL
env.desc: 形如 postgresql://user:pass@host:5432/db 的连接串。

mcp.name: SQLite
mcp.tagline: 查本地 SQLite 库（自建题库/卡片库）
mcp.taglineEn: Query local SQLite databases (question banks, decks)
mcp.desc: 社区维护的 MCP server：直接读写一个本地 .db 文件，做自建题库、实验数据记录很合适。
mcp.descEn: Community MCP server: reads/writes a local .db file — good for self-built question banks and experiment logs.
mcp.author: 社区

env.name: SQLITE_DB_PATH
env.desc: 本地 .db 文件的绝对路径。
env.descEn: Absolute path to a local .db file.

mcp.name: EverArt
mcp.tagline: 多模型图片生成（医学插图、示意图）
mcp.desc: 官方 MCP server：调 EverArt 的多个生图模型产示意图，配合本应用的生成图片资产流使用。
mcp.descEn: Official MCP server: EverArt's image models for illustrations — pairs well with this app's generated-image asset flow.
mcp.author: Model Context Protocol

env.name: EVERART_API_KEY
env.desc: EverArt API 密钥（需注册账号）。

mcp.name: Context7
mcp.tagline: 实时拉官方库文档进上下文（远端直连）
mcp.taglineEn: Live library docs in context (remote endpoint)
mcp.desc: Upstash 出品的远端 MCP：不用本地起进程，直接 HTTP 接入，给 Agent 喂最新版库的官方文档。
mcp.descEn: A remote MCP by Upstash — no local process, plain HTTP — feeding up-to-date official library docs to the agent.
mcp.author: Upstash

env.name: CONTEXT7_API_KEY
env.desc: 可选：绑定账号提升限额；不填也能匿名用。
env.descEn: Optional: bind an account for higher rate limits; anonymous use works.

mcp.name: Tavily
mcp.tagline: 为 Agent 优化的搜索与网页抓取 API
mcp.taglineEn: Search + extraction API built for agents
mcp.desc: 社区常用的搜索 MCP：结果为 RAG 场景优化（带摘要、可抓取正文），Brave 之外的另一路联网检索。
mcp.descEn: A popular search MCP: results tuned for RAG (with summaries and page extraction) — an alternative to Brave.
mcp.author: Tavily

env.name: TAVILY_API_KEY
env.desc: Tavily API 密钥（注册即送免费额度）。
env.descEn: Tavily API key (free tier on signup).

mcp.name: Exa
mcp.tagline: 语义搜索引擎，找论文与资料更准
mcp.taglineEn: Semantic search — sharper for papers and references
mcp.desc: 社区常用的语义搜索 MCP：按意思而不是关键词找内容，查文献、找相似资料比关键词搜索更贴。
mcp.descEn: A popular semantic-search MCP: matches by meaning rather than keywords — better for literature and lookalike sources.
mcp.author: Exa

env.name: EXA_API_KEY
env.desc: Exa API 密钥（有免费额度）。
env.descEn: Exa API key (free credits on signup).

cli.name: uv
cli.tagline: Python 包与工具极速管理器（mcp-server-* 的 uvx 都靠它）
cli.taglineEn: Fast Python package/tool runner — powers the uvx-based MCP servers
cli.desc: Astral 出品的 Python 工具链：一行装好就有 uv/uvx。Fetch、Time、SQLite 这几个 MCP 都以 uvx 形式跑。
cli.descEn: Astral's Python toolchain: one install gives you uv/uvx — the runtime for the Fetch, Time and SQLite MCP servers.
cli.author: Astral

cli.name: Claude Code
cli.desc: 终端里的编码/资料整理 Agent，原生支持 MCP 与 SKILL.md——从本市场复制的 MCP 配置可直接喂给它。
cli.descEn: Anthropic's terminal agent for coding and research; natively supports MCP and SKILL.md — configs copied here plug straight in.
cli.author: Anthropic

cli.name: Codex CLI
cli.tagline: OpenAI 官方终端编码 Agent
cli.desc: OpenAI 的终端 Agent：跑任务、改代码、调 MCP 工具都行，配置文件是 ~/.codex/config.toml。
cli.descEn: OpenAI's terminal agent: run tasks, edit code, call MCP tools; config lives in ~/.codex/config.toml.
cli.author: OpenAI

cli.name: Gemini CLI
cli.desc: Google 的终端 Agent，免费额度大，支持 MCP 与自定义指令文件（GEMINI.md）。
cli.descEn: Google's terminal agent with a generous free tier; supports MCP and a GEMINI.md instruction file.
cli.author: Google

cli.name: FFmpeg
cli.tagline: 音视频转码/剪辑/抽帧的事实标准
cli.taglineEn: The standard for audio/video transcode, trim, frame extraction
cli.desc: 处理录课音频、抽视频关键帧、转格式都靠它；Agent 多媒体管线的基础件。
cli.descEn: The workhorse for lecture audio, keyframe extraction and format conversion — a base piece of any agent media pipeline.
cli.author: FFmpeg 社区
cli.install: brew install ffmpeg  # macOS；apt install ffmpeg  # Ubuntu

cli.name: Pandoc
cli.taglineEn: Universal document converter (md ↔ docx ↔ pdf ↔ epub)
cli.desc: 笔记导出 Word/PDF、把课件 docx 转回 Markdown 喂给 AI，都是一行命令的事。
cli.descEn: Export notes to Word/PDF or turn courseware docx back into Markdown for the AI — one command either way.
cli.author: Pandoc 社区
cli.install: brew install pandoc  # macOS；apt install pandoc  # Ubuntu

cli.name: ImageMagick
cli.tagline: 批量图像处理：缩放/裁剪/拼接/转格式
cli.taglineEn: Batch image ops: resize, crop, montage, convert
cli.desc: 整理病理/组胚图谱时批量裁图、压图、拼版都靠它；配合 Agent 可一句话跑完一套处理。
cli.descEn: Batch crop/compress/montage for pathology and histology atlases — the agent can run a whole pipeline in one line.
cli.author: ImageMagick 社区
cli.install: brew install imagemagick  # macOS；apt install imagemagick  # Ubuntu

cli.name: ripgrep
cli.tagline: 毫秒级全文搜索，找笔记/代码必备
cli.taglineEn: Millisecond full-text search for notes and code
cli.desc: 在本地 Markdown 库、导出的课件里秒级定位关键词；Agent 做本地检索时最常用的底层工具。
cli.descEn: Instant keyword hits across Markdown libraries and exported courseware — the go-to local search tool for agents.
cli.author: Andrew Gallant
cli.install: brew install ripgrep  # macOS；apt install ripgrep  # Ubuntu

cli.name: yt-dlp
cli.tagline: 抓公开课视频与字幕，喂给笔记流水线
cli.taglineEn: Grab lecture videos and subtitles for your notes pipeline
cli.desc: 下载教学视频与字幕轨（需自行确认版权许可），转给转写/笔记工具链做结构化摘要。
cli.descEn: Download lecture videos and subtitle tracks (check licensing first) to feed transcription and note pipelines.
cli.author: yt-dlp 社区
cli.install: pipx install yt-dlp  # 或 brew install yt-dlp

cli.name: Anthropic Skills
cli.tagline: Anthropic 官方 Agent Skills 示例库
cli.desc: 官方维护的 SKILL.md 集合：PDF/DOCX/XLSX/PPTX 文档技能、网页测试、MCP 生成等。每个 skill 一个目录，拷出单个 SKILL.md 即可导入本应用技能库。
cli.descEn: The official SKILL.md collection: document skills (PDF/DOCX/XLSX/PPTX), web testing, MCP generation and more — copy any single SKILL.md into this app's skill library.
cli.notes: 看官方怎么写 frontmatter 与正文结构，是自建 skill 最好的参照。
cli.notesEn: The best reference for writing your own skills: official frontmatter and body structure.
cli.author: Anthropic

cli.name: Superpowers
cli.tagline: 社区最火的 Agent 工作流技能库（TDD/调试/规划）
cli.taglineEn: The community's most popular agent-workflow skill library (TDD, debugging, planning)
cli.desc: obra/Superpowers：一整套可组合的工程方法论 skills——头脑风暴、系统化调试、TDD、代码评审。Claude Code 可插件安装，其余 Agent 可拷 SKILL.md 导入。
cli.descEn: obra/Superpowers: a composable engineering-methodology skill set — brainstorming, systematic debugging, TDD, code review. Installable as a Claude Code plugin, or copy SKILL.md files into this app.
cli.notes: 在 Claude Code 里装插件最省事；本应用则挑单个 SKILL.md 导入。
cli.notesEn: Easiest as a plugin inside Claude Code; for this app, import individual SKILL.md files.
cli.author: Jesse Vincent (obra)

cli.name: Awesome Agent Skills
cli.tagline: 按厂商/团队分类的官方 Skills 大清单
cli.taglineEn: A huge curated index of official skills by vendor and team
cli.desc: VoltAgent 维护的收录清单：Anthropic、Google Labs、Vercel、Stripe、Cloudflare 等官方 skill 全在里面，兼容 Claude Code / Codex / Gemini CLI / Cursor 等。逛清单→挑单个 skill→导入本应用。
cli.descEn: VoltAgent's curated index of 1000+ official skills — Anthropic, Google Labs, Vercel, Stripe, Cloudflare and more — compatible with Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor. Browse, pick, import.
cli.author: VoltAgent

cli.name: skills.sh
cli.tagline: Agent Skills 注册表：按热度发现可装的 skill
cli.taglineEn: The Agent Skills registry — discover skills by install count
cli.desc: skills.sh 是 Agent Skills 的公共注册表与安装排行：看哪些 skill 真有人在用，直接给出 npx skills add 的安装命令。
cli.descEn: skills.sh is the public registry and install leaderboard for Agent Skills — see what's actually used, and get an npx skills add command per skill.
cli.author: Vercel

skills.name: LaTeX 公式检查
skills.tagline: 核对笔记/回答里的 KaTeX 公式能否正确渲染
skills.taglineEn: Verify KaTeX formulas in notes and answers actually render
skills.desc: 让 Agent 在写公式前后自查：定界符配对、命令合法性、KaTeX 支持范围（本应用用 KaTeX 渲染，不支持 \ce、\pu 等需宏扩展的命令会提前提示替代写法）。
skills.descEn: Makes the agent self-check formulas before writing: delimiter pairing, command validity and KaTeX coverage (this app renders via KaTeX — unsupported macros like \ce/\pu get flagged with alternatives up front).
skills.author: StudySolo

skills.name: 考研真题解析模板
skills.tagline: 五段式拆真题：考点→题眼→步骤→易错→变式
skills.taglineEn: Five-part exam breakdown: topic → trigger → steps → traps → variants
skills.desc: 把一道真题按「考点定位 / 题眼拆解 / 规范解题 / 易错警示 / 变式练习」五段展开，输出一致格式的解析，适合刷题后沉淀错题本。
skills.descEn: Expands one real exam question into a fixed five-part analysis — topic mapping, stem reading, model solution, common traps, variant drills — ideal for building a mistake notebook.
skills.author: StudySolo

skills.name: 笔记整理助手
skills.tagline: 把零散记录收成层级大纲 + 术语表 + 自检问题
skills.taglineEn: Turn scattered notes into an outline, glossary and self-quiz
skills.desc: 让 Agent 把课堂速记/划线摘录整理成：层级大纲（≤3 级）、术语速查表、每条主干的「一句话总结」、末尾附 3-5 个自检问题，可直接粘回笔记。
skills.descEn: Reshapes raw class notes and highlights into: a ≤3-level outline, a quick glossary, one-line takeaways per branch, and 3–5 self-check questions — ready to paste back into your notes.
skills.author: StudySolo
